privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: At Digitip we take your privacy seriously. This policy explains what data we collect, how we use it, and the rights you have over it. The data controller is YUZU LABS SAS, the company operating the Digitip service — SIREN 994 879 013, 11 rue de Lorraine, 68490 Petit-Landau, France.
privacy.s1Body: Account data (name, email, password hash), business data (company name, VAT, shipping/billing address), tipping data (amount, date, recipient staff member), payout data handled by Stripe (bank account, identity verification), and technical data (IP address, browser, language) used for security and analytics.
privacy.s2Body: To operate the service (process tips, manage staff, issue invoices), to comply with legal obligations (accounting, tax, anti-money laundering), to improve the product, and to contact you about your account. We never sell your data.
privacy.s3Body: Card data is collected and processed exclusively by Stripe. Digitip servers never see or store card numbers. Stripe acts as an independent data controller for payment and KYC data. See stripe.com/privacy for details.
privacy.s4Body: We share data only with: Stripe (payments), Supabase (authentication & database hosting, EU region), Resend/our email provider (transactional emails), and authorities when legally required.
privacy.s5Body: Account data is kept as long as your account is active, plus 3 years for commercial records. Accounting records (invoices, tips) are kept 10 years as required by law. You can request deletion at any time.
privacy.s6Body: You can access, correct, delete or export your data, object to processing, and lodge a complaint with your local data protection authority (CNIL in France). Email privacy@digitip.app to exercise your rights.
privacy.s7Body: We use strictly necessary cookies for authentication and session management. We do not use advertising cookies or third-party trackers.
privacy.s8Body: Data is encrypted in transit (TLS 1.2+) and at rest. Access is restricted to authorised staff. We conduct regular security reviews.
privacy.s9Body: For any question about this policy, or to exercise your rights, email privacy@digitip.app or write to YUZU LABS SAS — Data Protection, 11 rue de Lorraine, 68490 Petit-Landau, France.

terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.intro: These terms govern your use of Digitip. By creating an account or placing an order, you accept them in full.
terms.s1Body: Digitip provides NFC SmartTags and software that lets customers leave contactless tips to staff. Tips are collected via Stripe and then paid out to the designated recipient's bank account, after their identity is verified. Digitip acts as a technical facilitator and is not the recipients' employer.
terms.s2Body: You must be at least 18, have the authority to bind your business, and operate a lawful hospitality or service activity in a country where Stripe Connect is available.
terms.s3Body: SmartTag packs are sold as a one-time hardware purchase. There is no subscription and no monthly fee: once the plaque is paid for, no recurring amount is charged. The Digitip platform earns revenue solely through a service fee added on top of the tip and paid by the person leaving it (see section 5). Nothing is taken out of the tip itself: the recipient receives the full amount chosen. With no tips, nothing is owed. Hardware is non-refundable once shipped, without prejudice to the legal warranties and the right of withdrawal set out in the terms of sale.
terms.s4Body: All payments are processed by Stripe. VAT is applied automatically according to your country. Hardware is paid for once, at the time of the order; no recurring charge is made. A 30-day grace period applies to SmartTags before full deactivation if the account is closed.
terms.s5Body: Digitip acts as a technical payment facilitator. Each tip is attributed to the staff member chosen by the customer. Funds are first collected via Stripe, then paid out to the recipient's connected bank account as soon as they complete the identity verification required by anti-money-laundering rules. Until that verification is complete, the tip is held securely and paid out automatically once the recipient is verified. Digitip takes nothing out of the tip: its revenue comes from the service fee added on top of the chosen amount and paid by the customer, who is shown the exact figure before confirming payment. That fee covers bank processing costs and running the service. Digitip only holds funds for as long as needed to pay them out.
terms.s6Body: You must provide accurate information, keep credentials safe, use the service lawfully, inform your staff and customers appropriately, and comply with applicable tax and employment laws regarding tips.
terms.s7Body: You may not use Digitip for fraudulent transactions, money laundering, prohibited activities under Stripe's terms, or to process payments unrelated to tipping.
terms.s8Body: Digitip is provided as-is. To the maximum extent permitted by law, our total liability is limited to the amounts paid by you to Digitip in the 12 months preceding the claim. We are not liable for indirect damages, lost profits, or data loss beyond our control.
terms.s9Body: You may close your account at any time. We may suspend or terminate access if you breach these terms or create risk for us, payment partners or other users. On termination, SmartTags are deactivated after 30 days.
terms.s10Body: These terms are governed by French law. Disputes between businesses are subject to the exclusive jurisdiction of the courts within the remit of the Colmar Court of Appeal, unless mandatory consumer law provides otherwise.
terms.s11Body: We may update these terms. Material changes will be notified by email at least 30 days before they apply.
terms.s12Body: To receive tips, each recipient must confirm their identity and provide an IBAN through Stripe's secure flow. This step, required by EU regulation (KYC / AML), is kept to the strict minimum and is only requested when the recipient wishes to collect the amounts attributed to them.
terms.s13Body: If a recipient does not complete identity verification, the tips attributed to them are held for them. If they remain unclaimed for 90 days, they are automatically refunded to the customer who made the payment. Digitip holds no unclaimed funds beyond that period.
terms.s14Body: Digitip is not the recipients' employer and is not involved in the employment relationship or payroll. Tips paid directly to employees may qualify for an exemption from social contributions and income tax under applicable rules, subject to conditions. It is the establishment's and/or the recipient's responsibility to meet their reporting obligations (in particular in payroll). To help, Digitip provides the administrator with a monthly statement of amounts paid to each recipient. Digitip does not provide legal or tax advice.

cgv.title: Terms of Sale
cgv.intro: These Terms of Sale (ToS) govern all orders for products and services placed on digitip.app. By confirming an order, the buyer unconditionally accepts these Terms. Seller: YUZU LABS SAS, 11 rue de Lorraine, 68490 Petit-Landau — SIREN 994 879 013 — contact@digitip.app.
cgv.s1Body: YUZU LABS SAS sells under the Digitip brand: (1) pre-programmed NFC epoxy plaques ("SmartTags") enabling customers to leave contactless tips, and (2) access to the Digitip software platform (dashboard, staff management, analytics). Essential product characteristics are detailed on the order pages.
cgv.s2Body: Prices are shown in euros excluding VAT. Applicable VAT is calculated by Stripe at checkout based on your country of tax residence. YUZU LABS SAS reserves the right to change prices at any time; orders are invoiced at the price shown at the time of confirmation. Delivery is free across Europe.
cgv.s3Body: Any order placed on digitip.app constitutes acceptance of these Terms, the prices, and the product descriptions. YUZU LABS SAS reserves the right to refuse or cancel any order in cases of suspected fraud, unresolved prior dispute, or product unavailability. A confirmation email is sent within 24 hours of validation.
cgv.s4Body: Payment is made in full online at the time of order via Stripe (debit/credit card, Apple Pay, Google Pay). Payment data is collected and processed exclusively by Stripe — YUZU LABS SAS servers never see or store any banking data. In the event of payment failure, the order is automatically cancelled.
cgv.s5Body: SmartTags are dispatched from France within 3 to 5 business days following payment confirmation. Delivery is free across Europe. A tracking email is sent upon shipment. YUZU LABS SAS cannot be held liable for delays attributable to the carrier, force majeure, or incorrect delivery information provided by the buyer.
cgv.s6Body: In accordance with Article L221-18 of the French Consumer Code, any consumer (non-professional buyer) has 14 calendar days from receipt of the parcel to exercise their right of withdrawal, without reason or penalty. Products must be returned unused, in their original packaging, at the buyer's expense. Refund will be made within 14 days of receipt and verification of the return. This right does not apply to orders placed for professional purposes (B2B), or to products that have been used or damaged after delivery.
cgv.s7Body: SmartTags benefit from the statutory warranty of conformity (Articles L217-3 et seq. of the French Consumer Code — 2 years from delivery for non-professional buyers) and the warranty against hidden defects (Articles 1641 et seq. of the French Civil Code). In addition, YUZU LABS SAS offers a lifetime commercial warranty: any SmartTag showing a manufacturing defect or failure under normal use will be replaced free of charge upon sending a photo to contact@digitip.app.
cgv.s8Body: For any after-sales request, contact contact@digitip.app with your order number. YUZU LABS SAS will respond within 48 business hours and process any guaranteed replacement within 5 business days of confirmation.
cgv.s9Body: Using the Digitip platform to collect tips does not result in any deduction from the tips collected: the recipient receives the full amount chosen by the customer. The service fee — a fixed part of €0.25 per transaction and a variable part of 5% of the tip — is added on top of the tip and paid by the person leaving it, who is shown the exact figure before confirming payment. That fee covers payment processing (Stripe), infrastructure hosting, fraud prevention and service maintenance. No fee is due if no tips are collected.
cgv.s10Body: YUZU LABS SAS cannot be held liable for indirect damages (lost profits, loss of customers, data loss) related to the use or inability to use SmartTags or the platform. The liability of YUZU LABS SAS is limited to amounts actually paid by the buyer in the 12 months preceding the loss.
cgv.s11Body: In the event of an unresolved dispute, any consumer may use a free approved mediator: CM2C — Centre de la Médiation de la Consommation de Conciliateurs de Justice, 14 rue Saint-Jean, 75017 Paris — www.cm2c.net. The European Commission also provides an online dispute resolution platform: ec.europa.eu/consumers/odr. Disputes between professionals fall under the exclusive jurisdiction of the courts of the Colmar Court of Appeal, unless mandatory law provides otherwise. These Terms are governed by French law.

faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.q1: Is it compatible with all smartphones?
faq.a1: 90% of recent smartphones support NFC. For the rest, every SmartTag also includes a QR code scannable with the phone camera. 100% compatibility guaranteed.
faq.q2: Can customers pay with Apple Pay or Google Pay?
faq.a2: Yes. The Digitip payment page accepts Apple Pay, Google Pay and all debit/credit cards — no app needed for the customer.
faq.q3: How long does a SmartTag last?
faq.a3: Indefinitely. There's no battery, no active electronics. The SmartTag works by induction. We offer lifetime replacement if it breaks.
faq.q4: Can Digitip be used across multiple venues?
faq.a4: Yes. A single Digitip account can manage unlimited venues and teams, each with their own SmartTags and analytics.
faq.q5: My plaque is damaged or defective — what do I do?
faq.a5: No problem. Lifetime hardware replacement is included with every pack. Email us a photo and we'll ship a new one free of charge.
faq.q6: Do I need a company number or a specific status?
faq.a6: Not to order SmartTags. To collect tips, the business verifies itself once, right inside Digitip (the manager's identity and bank details) — the check anti-money-laundering rules require. Your employees have no account to create and nothing to do: tips are attributed to them by name and you pass them on through payroll.
faq.a7: From the service fee, paid by the person leaving the tip — never from the tip itself. For a €10 tip the customer pays €10.75 in total: €0.25 fixed plus 5% of the tip. You receive the full €10. Of the 75 cents of fees, about €0.41 goes to Stripe (€0.25 fixed + 1.5% of the amount charged) and €0.34 goes to Digitip for infrastructure, support and ongoing development. No subscription, no monthly fee, and nothing out of your pocket.

banking.subtitle: Receive your tips in your bank account.

banking.step1Body: To pay out your tips securely, we use Stripe — the world's leading payment provider, trusted by millions of businesses. Stripe protects your money and your details: Digitip never has access to them.
banking.step2Body: It takes about 2 minutes, just once. After that, your tips reach your bank account — Stripe handles the payouts, at the frequency you choose.
banking.step3Body: You receive your tips personally, as a private individual. Setting up Stripe doesn't make you a business and commits you to nothing.
banking.pendingBalanceBody: Finish your verification (2 min) to receive these tips in your account.
banking.incompleteBody: Resume the secure setup to receive your tips.
banking.step4Body: Stripe only offers two account types: “individual / sole trader” or “company”. Keep the pre-selected “Individual / sole trader” (never “Company”) — no company details to provide.
banking.step5Body: Just have your date of birth, your address and your IBAN handy. That's all Stripe needs to pay out your tips.
banking.step6Body: Stripe may offer extra add-ons (Tax, Climate). You don't need them: click “Not now” and carry on. You're all set!
